items.stem: A company publishes a one-page 'AI Principles' document and calls it its AI policy. What is the gap?

options.text: Principles state intent; a policy must set enforceable, testable requirements and consequences
options.rationale: Correct: enforceable policy differs from aspirational principles.

options.text: The document should have been longer
options.rationale: Length is not the issue; enforceability is.

options.text: Principles must be approved by regulators
options.rationale: Internal policy does not require regulator approval.

options.text: Nothing, principles and policy are the same

items.explanation: Correct: enforceable policy differs from aspirational principles.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO are strengths of a federated (business-unit-led) AI governance model? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Decisions sit closer to domain context and move faster
options.rationale: Correct: proximity to context and speed are federated strengths.

options.text: Business units own and are accountable for their AI risk
options.rationale: Correct: distributed ownership is a federated strength.

options.text: It guarantees fully consistent standards everywhere
options.rationale: Consistency is a weakness, not a strength, of federation.

options.text: It removes the need for any central policy
options.rationale: Federated models still need shared central policy.

items.explanation: Correct: proximity to context and speed are federated strengths.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Leadership wants one governance metric for the board. Which is most useful?

options.text: Share of deployed AI use cases that passed the required review, with exceptions tracked
options.rationale: Correct: it shows governance coverage and surfaces exceptions.

options.text: Total number of AI models built
options.rationale: A raw count says nothing about governance.

options.text: Average model accuracy across the firm
options.rationale: Accuracy is not a governance coverage measure.
Vendor contacts do not reflect governance.

items.explanation: Correct: it shows governance coverage and surfaces exceptions.
